properties.description:

Waters from Savannah GA to Altamaha Sound GA out 60 NM...

capable of producing winds to around 30 knots. This strong
thunderstorm was located near A L T Buoy, moving east at 10 knots.

Grays Reef Buoy, Sapelo Buoy S, Honey Barge, Steel Barge Modena,
Tug Rio Apon, Tug Elmira, Buoy J, K T K Buoy, Ferry Boat Janet,
Buoy Tender Sagebrush, D R H Buoy, Tug Rio Caroni, John Bird, Buoy

agency. They will relay your report to the National Weather Service
office.
